# What this project knows

Every container has an index. This is the project's: one entry per bundle, what each is for, and what brings it into play. A bundle's own index sits at `<bundle-id>/INDEX.md` beside this file — open it when the bundle's line matches the work, and not before. Procedures are installed in your harness as skills and are not listed here.
